environment.execution: All measurements below used CPU only. Swift compiled with optimizations and Core ML used MLComputeUnits.cpuOnly.
environment.physical_vram: Unified system memory shared by the Apple GPU
environment.visible_vram: No separate VRAM was allocated or queried. GPU and Neural Engine were unused.
environment.evidence: system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType, sysctl hw.memsize and explicit MLModelConfiguration.computeUnits
environment.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0
environment.co_resident_load: Other development, conversion and validation jobs may have run. System load and thermal state were not isolated.

workload: Swift audio window packing of 1×200×12×768 FP16 features and full PRO320 Wav2Vec2 plus conditioning projection with the production compiled models.
synthetic_input: Contiguous Float16. At flat offset i the value is ((i % 31) - 15) / 8.
real_input: The first 35,840 samples of artifacts/coreml/Smoke/active_speech.wav left-padded with zeros to 128,000 samples (the second window). Exact PCM bytes are identical in both runs.
method: Each executable measured six synthetic packings, then three real predictions. Each real invocation loaded both production models, predicted the audio features, packed overlapping windows and projected conditioning. Iterations 1 and 2 are warm. Values are monotonic wall seconds. The baseline source came from fec3bf7. Model outputs were independently hashed in both executables.
evidence_scope: This CPU-only standalone probe measures audio-side work on the M5 Pro. Target device FPS requires an end-to-end iPhone run.

bulk_copy_pack.validation: Checks all 35 selected feature rows for NaN and infinity before packing. Final CPU-only timing includes this guard.

worker_proof.workload: Same production FP32 audio model and INT8 conditioning projection requested on CPU only in both paths. Compared serial results with a separate actor returning immutable context values.
worker_proof.selection: The worker takes the same requested compute units as serial generation. This historical CPU-only probe explicitly requested CPU in both execution paths.

experimental_weight_storage.policy: FP16 storage for weights and biases on the 73 linear and eight convolution operations. The graph retains FP32 activations. The shipping audio model keeps its FP32 weights.
experimental_weight_storage.decision: The initial load was shorter and peak process memory was lower, while steady-state CPU audio predictions took longer. The storage experiment used the bulk-copy packer before finite validation in both weight configurations.
